summary: Take a basis m of L₀ = link γ ∩ link γ' ∩ ker zFormPair; p = its X₀-rows spans T° = commonLink, and m*·LM·m = p*p. Extend m to a basis (m | u) of L = link γ ∩ link γ' and then to a basis (m | u | y) of link γ by vectors y independent modulo L (exists_basis_extend_ker twice). Lift the whole basis (exists_lifts_linkDiscSq_le), split off y and then u orthogonally (exists_orthogonal_split); bound latticeDisc(c, T°)·frameValueIndex by the discriminant of the m-lifts (sublatticeDisc_mul_index_sq_le), and minorNorm² by linkDiscSq(u, ·)·max² (minorNorm_sq_le_linkDiscSq_mul); the product of the three discriminants is the discriminant of the full lift, ≤ minorNorm²/w², which assembles to the class-gauge bound.

steps.claim: m: a basis matrix of L₀ = link γ ∩ link γ' ∩ ker zFormPair(T) (b: left inverse, e: its span).
steps.lean:
choose m b e using
    exists_basis_matrix (link γ ⊓ link γ' ⊓ (zFormPair (S.ratMiddle E)).mulVecLin.ker)

steps.claim: Its columns lie in link γ (i) and zFormPair(T)·m = 0 (hl).
steps.lean: choose i hl using (le_inf_iff.1 e.le).imp inf_le_left.trans' mul_eq_zero_of_range_le_ker

steps.claim: hQ: m*·linkMetric·m = p*p (the z-rows vanish, and the link form is zero on the link, so ½(T ⊕ T) restricted to the link equals the X₀-part).
steps.lean:
have hQ : mᴴ * S.linkMetric * m = pᴴ * p := have := gram_linkForm_eq_zero_of_le_link i i
    by simp_all [← ext_iff, linkMetric, mul_apply, p, middleGram, add_neg_eq_zero, ← two_mul]

steps.claim: commonLink(γ, γ') = colSpan(p); unfold pairInvariant, latticeDisc and frameValueIndex (with a = 1).
steps.lean:
rw [pairInvariant, latticeDisc, frameValueIndex, one_smul,
    (by ext; simp [commonLink, ← e]; rfl : commonLink γ γ' = colSpan p)]

steps.claim: Extend m to a basis (m | u) of L (exists_basis_extend_ker with det(m*LMm) ≠ 0): u has r columns with zFormPair·u having a left inverse (k, l, O, o),
steps.lean:
choose r u _ i k l O o using
    exists_basis_extend_ker (det_gram_linkMetric_ne_zero b) (e ▸ inf_le_left)

steps.claim: and (m | u) to a basis (m | u | y) of link γ with y independent modulo L (i', k', l', O', o').
steps.lean:
choose s y _ i' k' l' O' o' using
    exists_basis_extend_ker (det_gram_linkMetric_ne_zero i) (k ▸ inf_le_left)

steps.claim: Lift: e with HasIntegralLifts of the whole basis and linkDiscSq·w² ≤ minorNorm² (q), w ≠ 0.
steps.lean: choose _ P q w using exists_lifts_linkDiscSq_le h hc i' k'

steps.claim: Split off y orthogonally (O'): lifts of (m | u)·a' and of (m|u)z + y·v, with multiplied discriminants (q₁).
steps.lean: choose _ v z P p₂ q₁ using P.exists_orthogonal_split O'

steps.claim: Split (m | u) into m and u (O): lifts of m·a and of m·z' + u·g, with multiplied discriminants (q₂).
steps.lean: choose a g _ p₃ p₄ q₂ using P.exists_orthogonal_split O

steps.claim: The integral matrix n of the m-lifts (exists_isIntMatrix at c'), and the dimension counts: #ρ = dim T° (p has a left inverse from hQ), r and s from the two extensions, dim link γ = k + 1.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨_, hn, _, h₁, e'⟩, n, n₁, n₂, _⟩ := p₃.exists_isIntMatrix c', card_eq_finrank_colSpan
    (v := p) ⟨(pᴴ * p)⁻¹ * pᴴ, by simp [hQ ▸ det_gram_linkMetric_ne_zero b]⟩,
    k ▸ card_eq_finrank_colSpan i, k' ▸ card_eq_finrank_colSpan i', finrank_link γ

steps.claim: The X₀-rows of n are classCoordX₀(c)·p·a (the relation e' at m·a, whose z-rows vanish).
steps.lean:
specialize e' (finAdeleMat p * a.1) (by clear * - hl; simp_all [← ext_iff, mul_apply, p,
    middleGram])

steps.claim: If s = 0 (no y) then L = link γ (equal dimensions).
steps.lean: have L (z : s = 0) := eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq inf_le_left (n₁ ▸ z ▸ n₂)

steps.claim: minorNorm_sq_le_linkDiscSq_mul for the u-part (y = u, the lift of m·z' + u·g, hp from L, hi from o): B: #u ≤ 1 + (j − ϱ)₊ and G: x'²minorNorm² ≤ linkDiscSq(u, g)·max².
steps.lean:
have ⟨B, G⟩ := minorNorm_sq_le_linkDiscSq_mul hs h hc hq u g (L · ▸ n₁) (by order) (.of_ker_le_bot
    fun t _ ↦ o t (by simp_all [l _])) p₄ (by simp [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.map_mul, hl])

steps.claim: sublatticeDisc_mul_index_sq_le for x = p, w = a: (latticeDisc(c, T°)·frameValueIndex)² ≤ linkDiscSq(m, a) (X), with 0 < latticeDisc and 1 ≤ the index (Y: part (i)); then the witnesses i = s, the dimension facts (omega), L, the spans, and the lift of m·z + y·v.
steps.lean:
refine (sublatticeDisc_mul_index_sq_le _ _ _ n le_rfl a (D :=
    S.linkDiscSq m a) (by simp [← genIndex_algebraMap, RingHom.map_det, linkDiscSq,
    hQ]) (by simp [linkDiscSq, hQ ▸ det_gram_linkMetric_ne_zero b, hQ, genIndex.apply_ne_zero_iff])
    (e' ▸ by tauto) fun j ↦ e' ▸ ⟨_, fun _ ↦ hn.neg _ j, congr($(xRows_conjTranspose_mul_eq h₁
    (by simp [*, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.map_mul]))ᵀ j)⟩
    ).elim fun X Y ↦ ⟨Y, s, _, _, _, y, v, z, by omega, by omega, L, k, l', k ▸ o', k', p₂, ?_⟩

steps.claim: The class-gauge bound: multiply by minorNorm² > 0 and combine G, q, q₁, q₂ and X: (pairInvariant·x')²·linkDiscSq(y, v)·minorNorm² ≤ … = classGauge²·minorNorm² (the definitions of classGauge and saturationIndex; grind-linarith on the resulting products).
steps.lean:
unfold linkDiscSq at *; grw [← mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ (pow_pos hc.minorNorm_pos 2), mul_pow,
    mul_right_comm (_ ^ 2), mul_assoc, G, ← q, ← q₁, ← q₂, mul_pow, X,
    classGauge]; apply le_of_eq; clear * - w; grind-linarith
